name: iPhone 12 mini

bottom.datum: 0.00 at left of bottom view; view drawn with display up and camera bump down, so 0.00 is the phone's left edge as seen from the front

notes: Dimension numbers on this drawing are vector outlines, not PDF text: pg.get_text('words') returns only the title/footer, so the verbatim text check cannot confirm any value; every number was read visually from crops at 3.5x-12x zoom and cross-checked by symmetry about the centre ordinate and by an independent tesseract OCR pass over the rendered sheet (which found all but a handful of the values; those were re-read at higher zoom). centreLine values are measured across the thickness (about half of it); which face they are taken from was not determined. Ring/silent switch values are for its POCKET (drawing labels 23.37 and 3.68 'POCKET CENTER', 2X 2.85 half-length, 2.15 pocket width). Plateau = outermost camera outline; an inner outline is also dimensioned at x 3.61-28.82, y 3.61-32.01. Corner radius of plateau not dimensioned. Flash and rear mic are inside the plateau. Connector width not dimensioned (connector height 2.70; recommended connector keepout 13.65 x 6.85 with 2X R3.40; bottom-view ordinates 27.89 and 36.33 straddle the 32.11 centre and appear to be the connector ends). Bottom ordinates: 17.78 21.49 25.71 27.89 36.33 38.50 42.73 50.94; port centre-line 3.69 from the face. Button protrusion from front view: switch 0.60, volume 0.45, side 0.45.
